text: I usually wake up at six thirty, and my morning begins with a glass of water and a short stretch. After a quick shower, I have a light breakfast of oatmeal and fruit while checking the news. My work schedule starts at nine, and I spend most of the day in meetings or writing reports. To stay active, I go for a thirty-minute run right after work, even when I feel tired. Back home, I cook dinner, read a few chapters of a book, and plan the next day. By ten thirty, I’m in bed. This routine keeps me healthy and focused.
